name: Nancy Malone
bio: Nancy Malone was born on March 19, 1935 in Queens Village, Long Island, New York, USA. She was an actress and director, known for Naked City (1958), Capricorn One (1977) and The Long, Hot Summer (1965). She died on May 8, 2014 in Duarte, California, USA.
place: Queens Village, Long Island, New York, USA
